senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. טָעָה) [to move to and fro,] to be lost, go astray; to err.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81b:12">B. Kam. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>הרואה חבירו תּוֹעֶה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01227"><he>פָּסַג</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 81b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>וכן הוא שתעה וכ׳</he> (not <he>שתועה</he>) and so also he who has himself lost his way may &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:28">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 28</cite> <he>ת׳</he> (a. <he>טעה</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> (play on <he>כמ̇ת̇ע̇ת̇ע</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 27:12">Gen. XXVII, 12</cite>) <he>כמ̇ת̇ כת̇וע̇ה וכע̇ובד וכ׳</he> as one dead, as one going astray, and as one worshipping idols; Yalk. ib. 115 <he>כתועה וכעובד וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:3">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ת̇ו̇ע̇ב̇ה̇</he>) <he>תו̇ע̇ה אתה ב̇ה̇</he> thou (who committest it) losest thy senses through it; a. e.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 55a:13">Snh. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>מה אילנות … המַתְעֶה את חבירו מדרך וכ׳</he> if in the case of trees (that have been worshipped) … the Law says, destroy, burn, and exterminate: how much more does this apply to a man who leads his neighbor from the way of life to the way of death!; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 624:1">Yalk. Lev. 624</cite> <he>וּמַתְעֵהוּ מדרך וכ׳</he> (differ. in Sifra K’dosh. Par. 4, ch. X). Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>ונביאי … שהִתְעוּ אותי וכ׳</he> the false prophets …, who led me astray from the way of life &c.; a. e.
